verdict.rationale: Simular documents a REST API (POST /v1/agents/message, GET /v1/agents/events, POST /v1/agents/approve), so this axis applies. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no evidence points to any downloadable machine-readable spec. The llms.txt file, the prose endpoint list, the Python SDK and the MCP server are adjacent features, not an API specification.
